content:
anya: quick report: int4 packaging for nebula-lite introduced a token for an Ideographic Variation Sequence (IVS) codepoint. Small zh->ja eval shows BLEU drop ~2.0. repro below.

leo: short repro?

anya: yes:
```
input: "漢󠄀字"
float tokens -> ["漢字"]
int4 tokens -> ["漢","\uE0100","字"]
```
This preserves VS as its own token and detok inserts a space in some pipelines.

hannah: is this from sentencepiece rebuild or remapping during quant index truncation?

bryan: likely remap. packaging script rebuilds token ids by frequency bucket and can split combined tokens. We should preserve multi-codepoint tokens that existed in float.

anya: mitigation plan: (A) quick canary normalizer to strip VS for zh/ja route, (B) repack preserving float token table.

pack-bot: canary scheduled: nebula-lite-int4 -> canary-na at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z (rollout r-2026-03-22-001).

leo: i'll try a remap now. hannah: can you add IVS cases to detok regression suite?

hannah: adding 12 samples to detok/regress and packaging guard. local run shows int4 fails 8/12.

bryan: remap quick patch makes VS invisible again; uploaded s3://redwood-staging/models/nebula-lite-int4-remap-20260322.tar.gz

anya: thanks. filing issue ML-8718 and will track canary metrics. closing when repack released.
